boundary: The q=3,5,7 ranks are exact. The Hermitian duality and symbolic reductions are exact. No all-q rank proof is claimed.
equivalent_code_problem: binary code generated by the q^2+1-point generators (lines) of the Hermitian surface H(3,q^2)
equivalent_dual_statement: dim C^perp=q(q^2-q+1), with C^perp contained in C
gram_nilpotence: For odd q, line-graph parameters k=q^2(q+1), lambda=q^2-1, mu=q+1 are all even, so the SRG relation gives A^2=0 over F2.
literature_boundary: De Boeck--Vandendriessche, arXiv:1601.00443, studies dual codes of points/generators on H(2n+1,q^2), but in the defining characteristic and for weight structure; it does not supply this cross-characteristic binary dimension.
Bagchi--Brouwer--Wilbrink (1991) concerns square Sp(4,q) and its dual O(5,q), not elliptic Q^-(5,q).
status: OPEN: prove dim_F2 of the Hermitian-surface generator code equals theta_2(q^2) for every odd q.
theorem: The Q^-(5,q) rank conjecture is exactly a binary generator-code dimension problem on H(3,q^2), with target theta_2(q^2); Gram square-zero is automatic for odd q but does not determine the rank.
